- Update focused tests and progress documentation.

## Verification

- `npm --prefix .agent run build`

Closes #502

In-flight progress remains visible while the answer runs. Final comments retain the answer, model footer, and hidden progress marker, while `/implement` and `/fix-pr` keep their existing activity logs. Focused tests and documentation were updated accordingly. ## Review All three reviewers agree the current head is correctly scoped and safe to ship. One reviewer noted a future-facing routing consideration, but no reviewer identified a current defect or unresolved in-PR work. | Issue | Severity | Disposition | Description | | -- | -- | -- | -- | | Future `post-response` merge callers would also omit activity | INFO | FOLLOW_UP | The CLI currently hardcodes `includeActivity: false`, which is correct for every current merge-mode caller. Revisit only if a non-answer route later uses this path. | ## Progress - Current head `482548ba` matches the commit reviewed by all reviewers. - The hosted `Test Scripts / check` passed, and `git diff --check` is clean. - Tests cover both answer activity removal and preserved `/implement`/`fix-pr` behavior. - Documentation is synchronized, and no release notes were changed. - No inline comments or review threads exist; none were posted, replied to, minimized, or resolved. - The future-routing note is intentionally outside this PR’s bounded scope. ## Issue Details
Future post-response merge callers would also omit activity **Cause:** `includeActivity: false` is set at the general response CLI boundary, while the answer workflow is currently its only merge-mode caller. **Candidate solutions:** Keep the present surgical implementation. If another route later enables merge mode through `post-response`, make activity retention an explicit per-route or per-caller choice. **Comments:** This does not affect current behavior, and adding policy machinery now would expand the agreed scope.
